newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV suspends trading in Cubiertas.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV suspends trading in Cubiertas.

text.p: Spain's stock market commission CNMV on Thursday suspended trading in Cubiertas after the construction group announced a merger with Entrecanales.
Cubiertas y MZOV on Wednesday night told the commission it was absorbing Entrecanales y Tavora and its parent company Eur, making it the third largest construction group in Spain.
"(The merger) aims to build a large, diverse, efficient and profitable industrial group," Cubiertas said.
The construction group will expand its capital by 6.06 billion pesetas through a new share issue.
Shareholders in Eur will receive a new share in Cubiertas for every 367 they own. In the case of Entrecanales there will be no share swap as it is 100 percent owned by Eur.
